title: Rajamani vs. Karnataka State
summary: Disputed title precedents search returned landmark case civil appeal 44 (2018). Established that registration of sale deed requires verified physical possession boundary checks.

title: Venkatesh vs. Bangalore Municipal Corporation
summary: Land revenue records and mutation entries do not confer title. Declared that boundary disputes must be adjudicated by civil courts and not revenue officials.

title: Patel vs. Gowda
summary: Co-owner cannot transfer joint land property without clear division of holdings. Sale deed without partitioning was set aside.
